# Departed Digital

> A done-for-you service that closes or memorialises the online accounts of someone who has died. Families send the death certificate and proof of authority once; Departed Digital prepares every platform submission, chases every silence, and returns a written record of the outcome for each account. UK-based, serving families worldwide. Packages from £149.

Site: https://www.departed.digital
Contact: hello@departed.digital

## What we do
- Close or memorialise Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Google/Gmail, Apple/iCloud, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, Pinterest, YouTube, email providers, subscriptions and any other named account
- Prepare and submit each platform's official deceased-user process with the family's documents
- Follow up on delays and rejections until each account is resolved
- Provide a written record of what happened to every account
